title: Petri net input (JSON)
description: Canonical JSON form of a Petri net S = (P, T, I, O, mu0), the single intake model shared by all three channels (raw text, JSON, form; ADR-0003). Validation is two-pass: this schema (pass 1) checks structure only. Pass 2, run by the same validator and reported in the same 422 error format, enforces the cross-field rules JSON Schema cannot express: initial_marking keys must be exactly the declared places, and inputs/outputs keys (and their inner keys) must be declared transitions (and places).

places.description: Declared place names P, in order (unique identifier strings).

transitions.description: Declared transition names T, in order (unique identifier strings).

inputs.description: Input arcs I: transition -> (place -> positive integer weight). Optional key — absent = empty map (all input weights 0). Pass 2 enforces that every key is a declared transition and every inner key a declared place.

outputs.description: Output arcs O: transition -> (place -> positive integer weight). Optional key — absent = empty map (all output weights 0). Pass 2 enforces that every key is a declared transition and every inner key a declared place.

initial_marking.description: Initial marking mu0: place -> non-negative integer token count. Pass 2 enforces that the keys are exactly the declared places: a missing place is a validation error (not an implicit 0) and surplus keys are errors too.
